item.title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.

item.tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

answer_sheet.Face and retouching: Keep my facial proportions, expression, apparent age and natural skin texture. No face reshaping or beauty filter.

must_haves: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.

turns.text: I'd like you to turn this pic of me into a professional headshot, with just a bit of tidying rather than a whole new look. I always feel a little nervous about edited portraits because I still want to recognise myself when I see the finished image. What matters most, somewhere in all of that, is that you keep my face recognisably me and don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. It's really just the lighting, outfit and background that I'd like you to tidy up. I'm hoping this will feel like a more polished version of the photo rather than make me feel like I'm looking at somebody else.
turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the edit because your account doesn’t have enough credits, so no image was created or changed.

The edit is prepared to preserve your recognizable facial features, apparent age and natural skin texture, with changes limited to softer lighting, an understated professional outfit and a neutral background. Once credits are available, I can try again with those same constraints.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Make a restrained professional headshot edit of this exact photograph, not a reinterpretation or new person. Highest priority: preserve the woman's recognizable identity and exact facial proportions, face shape, eyes, nose, mouth, eyebrows, expression, skin tone and apparent age. Retain natural skin texture, pores and any lines or irregularities; no skin smoothing, beauty filters, de-aging, facial reshaping, makeup enhancement or beautification. Preserve her dark curly hair and hairline, pose and original square head-and-shoulders framing. Change only lighting, clothing and background: gently balance the exposure with soft natural professional portrait lighting, replace the gray casual sweater with a simple understated charcoal professional blazer over a plain top, and replace the park with a quiet neutral light gray studio background. Keep the result photographic and close to the original, like the same photo gently polished. No text.
